messages:
Alex: Hey team — ACME (enterprise) asked for our SOC 2 Type II report and wants temporary access to some artifacts for their auditor. They also requested a bridge letter and an NDA. Timeline: they'd like POC + evidence access next week (Mon-Wed). Can we confirm what's possible?

Jordan: @Alex we need signed NDA before we share any presigned links. Do we have a standard bridge-letter template? Legal can approve an exception for limited evidence access with NDA + bridging ack.

Maya: ACME wants to review config snapshots and a few infra logs. We can give redacted extracts in S3. Presigned links ok for a short window. How long do they need access?

Sam: Ideally 48 hours per artifact. Auditor will pull multiple files same day.

Priya: 48h presigned sounds fine if links are scoped & we add object-level logging. We must redact customer data. Also, no service-account keys in snapshots. Will require security review sign-off.

Olivia: I can prepare a zipped evidence bundle and generate presigned s3 links with 36h TTL. Example CLI to generate:

aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-poc/2026-03-XX/infra.zip --expires-in 129600

(we use 129600 for 36h)

Jordan: That CLI is fine. Legal: NDA + bridge-letter needed. @Maya please collect ACME signer info and send NDA link. Use our DocuSign template NDA-std-v3.

Maya: Sent DocuSign to sam@acme.example — also asked them to confirm auditor name and scope.

Alex: Also, pricing/POC note: ACME asked if dedicated capacity for POC is billable. Sales will cover first 5 days; beyond that we'll backcharge per our POC pricing. CC @finance.

Olivia: We should bucket artifacts: (1) config snapshots (redacted), (2) runtime logs (last 24h), (3) SOC 2 report PDF. SOC 2 PDF is hosted internally; Legal says we can share a redacted copy behind NDA.

Jordan: Confirmed — SOC2 PDF ok to share once NDA signed. For bridge letter: include statement of issuance date, coverage period, and that the full report is available under NDA. I'll draft and post.

Priya: Add audit trail: share S3 access logs and CloudTrail exports. Those are sensitive — must be redacted and approved.

Maya: Timeline update: NDA signed (signed_ts: 2119002450) by ACME legal. Olivia — can you push links today? Need to set TTL to 48h per their ask.

Olivia: Generating now. Links (36h as compromise): https://s3-presign.amazonaws.com/abc123-infra.zip (expires in 36h) :lock: I'll send direct to Sam only.

Alex: Great — Sam please confirm receipt. Once QA of redactions done, we can open logs.

Sam: Got the link, downloading now. Thanks everyone.

Jordan: I'll upload the bridge-letter draft to the thread for review.

Olivia: Note: Do not share links in any public channel. :warning: 

infra-bot: Evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-evidence/acme-poc/2119001111-infra.zip

Maya: Closing loop — POC schedule confirmed for next Tue-Wed. Logging this thread for audit.
